checklist.why: "The two ways a surface is presented" - drawer vs page.
Choosing between them: a drawer holds about five fields; a page form has Back.
Grab, close, subtitle, aside and the status line are not named here (only in TaskSheet).
Four sizes plus page, but dialog is a separate card and TaskSheet/TaskPage duplicate the drawer and page.
Static container; states belong to the contents (stated).
Preview footer buttons are 44px; the drawer close is 44x44 in farrowing and piglet processing.
Max two footer actions stated, but inspection.filters renders three (Back, Reset, Show pigs).
No title copy rules; the preview uses "Close", which TaskSheet bans.
No role=dialog/aria-modal or focus rule in this card; inspection drawers have only a grab bar (a gesture) plus Back, no close.
Raw #dce0d4 handle, #fff/white page, #b6c0ad Back border, 28px radius, raw padding.
Piglet processing stacks a drawer on a drawer (record-death over the pen sheet); no unsaved-change exit rule.
Does not link TaskSheet/TaskPage/TaskDialog or say which is canonical.
The 375 preview shows one short drawer only; no page, no sizes, no dialog.

variants.name: drawer (compact/short/medium/long, content-sized)
findings: Two implementations (.sheet in farrowing/inspection, .tk-sheet in piglet processing).
Inspection drawers are a fixed medium height with half of it empty; the footer pads 12/18 so the buttons end at 832px, on the handle bar (832-836).
Left edges disagree: inspection body 21 / footer 18; farrowing sow drawer body 18 / footer 21.
Close present in farrowing and piglet processing, absent in inspection.

variants.name: page (full canvas, Back footer)
findings: Renders the same across all three features, but through two implementations (.sheet[data-presentation=page] and TaskPage .tk-page).

variants.name: dialog (one question over a drawer)
findings: Lives only in TaskDialog and farrowing CSS; not documented on Sheet.

findings.text: One job, two implementations: Sheet (.sheet, farrowing + inspection) and TaskSheet/TaskPage (.tk-*, piglet processing) draw the same drawer and page with different gutters, heights and close rules.
findings.fix: Make Sheet the one card with variants drawer | page | dialog, implemented by the TaskSheet/TaskPage/TaskDialog code (the fixed one); port farrowing and inspection to it.

findings.text: Inspection drawer footers pad 12px 18px: the buttons end at y=832, on the 92x4 handle bar (832-836).
findings.fix: Use the footer padding 14/21/28 on every sheet footer (TaskSheet already does).

findings.text: The inspection.filters footer holds three actions (Back, Reset, Show pigs), breaking the two-action law.
findings.fix: Move Reset to a text action in the drawer head (aside), leaving Back + Show pigs.

findings.text: Fixed-height drawers with dead space and a distant footer (inspection.review-selected, inspection.filters).
The exit is inconsistent: the Sheet preview says "Close"; inspection drawers have no close; the farrowing Dead drawer swaps the close for Clear; TaskSheet bans Close.
findings.fix: One rule on Sheet: the footer exit is Back; drawers also carry the close IconButton; aside text actions sit left of it and never replace it.

findings.text: A drawer stacked on a drawer (piglet-processing.record-death over the pen sheet), against one overlay at a time.
findings.fix: Replace the pen drawer content in place (push), or use the dialog variant for a single question.

proposals.name: TaskSheet + TaskPage + TaskDialog -> Sheet (drawer | page | dialog)
proposals.why: Same job, two code paths; one card with three presentations.

proposals.name: TaskHold -> Sheet footer + Button hold
proposals.why: It is only the footer placement of the Button hold.
